scope: Controlled real-GPU interruption and exact-identity resume validation, not a new formal defense estimate.
recorder: Existing installed ReproLLM 0.6.1 in the verified study environment.

interruption.target: Only the newly launched owned recorder process, which forwards the signal to its child.

reference: Fresh uninterrupted 64-response execution with the identical development condition, on a separate available GPU.
comparison: Compare decoded output strings and scores per sample; report differences rather than editing results to match.
generation_accounting: Count completed recorded responses only. Interrupted in-flight requests may have consumed compute but are not counted as completed responses.
publication: Reviewed captures and derived checks; provenance tags may retain condition commits, with research updates pushed directly to main.
